service.status: Inspect the connected service instance and protocol version.
doctor: Inspect service readiness without opening new device connections.
devices.list: Refresh devices; disconnected mirror sessions may be cleaned up.
devices.capabilities: Refresh and inspect capabilities of one explicit device.
sessions.start: Start or reuse a device session and acquire a persistent client lease.
sessions.list: List sessions and their actual presentation states.
sessions.wait: Wait for a session state within the request deadline.
sessions.leases: List leases owned by the current client.
sessions.release: Release one lease owned by the current client.
sessions.stop: Release this client lease; close the backend only after its last owner leaves.
screen.capture: Capture a presented PNG frame with its geometry and freshness metadata.
input.tap: Tap at screenshot pixels using a current exported frame reference.
input.swipe: Swipe between screenshot pixels and always release the touch.
input.scroll: Scroll by normalized deltas at screenshot pixels.
input.text: Type text without clearing the focused field.
input.key: Press and release a supported named key.
overview.get: Read device overview for Android, Harmony or USB iOS.
apps.list: List installed applications on Harmony or for the current Android user. Optionally omit system apps.
apps.info: Read one application from device metadata. Android mainAbility is a package/activity component.
apps.top: Read the foreground application (non-system on Harmony) and its PID.
processes.list: Read the process snapshot on Android or Harmony.
apps.start: Launch a Harmony ability or Android package/activity component. Use mainAbility from apps.info.
apps.stop: Force stop an explicit Android or Harmony application.
apps.install: Install or replace from an absolute local APK (Android) or HAP (Harmony), up to 512 MiB.
apps.uninstall: Uninstall an explicit Android or Harmony application, removing its data. Never retried automatically.
apps.clear-data: Delete the selected Android or Harmony application data. Never retried automatically.
apps.clear-cache: Clear the selected application cache. Android requires pm clear --cache-only support.
shell.run: Execute one explicit Android or Harmony shell script with deadline, bounded output and exit status. May change device state; never retried automatically.
ports.list: List only the selected Harmony device mappings in the chosen direction.
ports.add: Create one explicit Harmony port mapping.
ports.remove: Remove only the explicitly named Harmony mapping; never remove all mappings.
logs.capture: Capture finite Android Logcat or Harmony HiLog output without clearing logs.
layout.dump: Export the Android UI Automator or Harmony UI hierarchy as bounded XML.
screen.snapshot: Capture a device screenshot without a mirror session (Android PNG, Harmony JPEG). For input coordinates use screen.capture.
webviews.list: List debuggable WebView pages of the foreground Android application.
mirrors.layout: Read the desktop mirror window layout.
mirrors.arrange: Arrange all active desktop mirror windows, including windows owned by other clients.
mirrors.focus: Show and focus an existing mirror for an explicit device, granting GUI ownership.
